039import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
040
041import java.io.File;
042import java.io.FileInputStream;

049
050/**
051 * YAMLAccount
052 *
053 * @author creatorfromhell
054 * @since 0.1.2.0
055 */
056public class YAMLAccount implements Datable<Account> {
057
058  /**
059   * The class that is represented by the O parameter.
060   *
061   * @return The class that represents the parameter.
062   */
063  @Override
064  public Class<? extends Account> clazz() {
065
066    return Account.class;
067  }
068
069  /**
070   * USed to purge the objects of this datable.
071   *
072   * @param connector The storage connector to use for this transaction.
073   */
074  @Override
075  public void purge(final StorageConnector<?> connector) {
076    //TODO: Yaml Purge
077  }
078
079  /**
080   * Used to store this object.
081   *
082   * @param connector The storage connector to use for this transaction.
083   * @param account   The object to be stored.
084   */
085  @Override
086  public void store(final StorageConnector<?> connector, @NotNull final Account account, @Nullable final String identifier) {
087
088    try {
089      storeAccount(connector, account, identifier);
090    } catch(final RuntimeException e) {
091      //The dirty flag is cleared when a save starts; restore it so the next save retries.
092      account.markDirty();
093      throw e;
094    }
095  }
096
097  private void storeAccount(final StorageConnector<?> connector, @NotNull final Account account, @Nullable final String identifier) {
098
099    PluginCore.log().debug("Saving Account with ID: " + identifier + " Name: " + account.getName(), DebugLevel.STANDARD);
100    final String file = "accounts/" + identifier + ".yml";
101
102    //Cleared before reading, so a change made while this save runs keeps the account dirty.
103    account.clearDirty();
104    waitForFile(file);
105    TNECore.yaml().add(file);
106    try {
107      final File accFile = new File(PluginCore.directory(), file);
108      if(!ensureAccountFile(accFile, account) ) {
109        account.markDirty();
110        return;
111      }
112
113      final YamlDocument yaml = loadDocument(accFile, account);
114      if(yaml == null) {
115        account.markDirty();
116        return;
117      }
118      writeAccount(yaml, account);
119      if(!saveDocument(yaml, account)) {
120        account.markDirty();
121        return;
122      }
123    } finally {
124      //A failed save must release the file, or every later save of this account waits forever.
125      TNECore.yaml().remove(file);
126    }
127    TNECore.instance().storage().storeAll(account.getIdentifier().toString());
128    PluginCore.callbacks().call(new AccountSaveCallback(account));
129  }
130
131  private void waitForFile(final String file) {
132
133    while(TNECore.yaml().inUse(file)) {
134      try {
135        Thread.sleep(1000);
136      } catch(final InterruptedException e) {
137        e.printStackTrace();
138      }
139    }
140  }
141
142  private boolean ensureAccountFile(final File accFile, final Account account) {
143
144    if(accFile.exists()) {
145      return true;
146    }
147    try {
148      accFile.createNewFile();
149      return true;
150    } catch(final IOException ignore) {
151      PluginCore.log().error("Issue creating account file. Account: " + account.getName(), DebugLevel.OFF);
152      return false;
153    }
154  }
155
156  private YamlDocument loadDocument(final File accFile, final Account account) {
157
158    try {
159      return YamlDocument.create(accFile);
160    } catch(final IOException ignore) {
161      PluginCore.log().error("Issue loading account file. Account: " + account.getName(), DebugLevel.OFF);
162      return null;
163    }
164  }
165
166  private void writeAccount(final YamlDocument yaml, final Account account) {
167
168    yaml.set("Info.ID", account.getIdentifier().toString());
169    yaml.set("Info.Name", account.getName());
170    yaml.set("Info.Type", account.type());
171    yaml.set("Info.Status", account.getStatus().identifier());
172    yaml.set("Info.CreationDate", account.getCreationDate());
173    yaml.set("Info.Pin", account.getPin());
174
175    if(account instanceof final PlayerAccount playerAccount) {
176      yaml.set("Info.LastOnline", playerAccount.getLastOnline());
177    }
178
179    if(account instanceof final SharedAccount shared) {
180      final String owner = (shared.getOwner() == null)? account.getIdentifier().toString() :
181                           shared.getOwner().toString();
182      yaml.set("Info.Owner", owner);
183      writeMembers(yaml, shared);
184    }
185  }
186
187  private void writeMembers(final YamlDocument yaml, final SharedAccount shared) {
188
189    for(final Member member : shared.getMembers().values()) {
190      for(final Map.Entry<String, Boolean> entry : member.getPermissions().entrySet()) {
191        yaml.set("Members." + member.getId() + "." + entry.getKey(), entry.getValue());
192      }
193    }
194  }
195
196  private boolean saveDocument(final YamlDocument yaml, final Account account) {
197
198    try {
199      yaml.save();
200      return true;
201    } catch(final IOException ignore) {
202      PluginCore.log().error("Issue saving account file. Account: " + account.getName());
203      return false;
204    }
205  }
206
207  /**
208   * Used to store all objects of this type.
209   *
210   * @param connector The storage connector to use for this transaction.
211   */
212  @Override
213  public void storeAll(final StorageConnector<?> connector, @Nullable final String identifier) {
214
215    for(final Account account : TNECore.eco().account().getAccounts().values()) {
216      if(account.isDirty()) {
217        storeIsolated(connector, account);
218      }
219    }
220  }
221
222  /**
223   * One account failing to save must not stop the rest of the save pass.
224   */
225  private void storeIsolated(final StorageConnector<?> connector, final Account account) {
226
227    try {
228      store(connector, account, account.getIdentifier().toString());
229    } catch(final RuntimeException e) {
230      PluginCore.log().error("Failed to save account " + account.getIdentifier() + "; retrying on the next save.",
231                             e, DebugLevel.OFF);
232    }
233  }
234
235  @Override
236  public void delete(final StorageConnector<?> connector, @NotNull final String identifier) {
237
238    PluginCore.log().debug("Deleting Account with ID: " + identifier, DebugLevel.STANDARD);
239
240    final String file = "accounts/" + identifier + ".yml";
241
242    final File accFile = new File(PluginCore.directory(), file);
243    if(accFile.exists()) {
244      accFile.delete();
245    }
246  }
247
248  /**
249   * Used to load this object.
250   *
251   * @param connector  The storage connector to use for this transaction.
252   * @param identifier The identifier used to identify the object to load.
253   *
254   * @return The object to load.
255   */
256  @Override
257  public Optional<Account> load(final StorageConnector<?> connector, @NotNull final String identifier) {
258
259    final File accFile = new File(PluginCore.directory(), "accounts/" + identifier + ".yml");
260    if(!accFile.exists()) {
261      PluginCore.log().error("Null account file passed to YAMLAccount.load. Account: " + identifier, DebugLevel.OFF);
262      return Optional.empty();
263    }
264    return load(accFile, identifier);
265  }
266
267  public Optional<Account> load(final File accFile, final String identifier) {
268
269    if(accFile == null) {
270
271      PluginCore.log().error("Null account file passed to YAMLAccount.load. Account: " + identifier, DebugLevel.OFF);
272      return Optional.empty();
273    }
274    try {
275      try(final FileInputStream fis = new FileInputStream(accFile)) {
276        final YamlDocument yaml = YamlDocument.create(fis);
277        if(yaml == null) {
278          return Optional.empty();
279        }
280        return loadAccount(yaml, identifier);
281      }
282    } catch(final Exception ignore) {
283
284      PluginCore.log().error("Issue loading account file. Account: " + identifier + ". You may need to remove this account file! This is due to a previous server crash or improper shutdown and not a bug.", DebugLevel.OFF);
285      return Optional.empty();
286    }
287
288  }
289
290  private Optional<Account> loadAccount(final YamlDocument yaml, final String identifier) {
291
292    if(!yaml.contains("Info.Name") || !yaml.contains("Info.Type")) {
293      PluginCore.log().error("Invalid account file. Account: " + identifier + ". You may need to remove this account file! This is due to a previous server crash or improper shutdown and not a bug.", DebugLevel.OFF);
294      return Optional.empty();
295    }
296
297    final String type = yaml.getString("Info.Type");
298    final AccountAPIResponse response = TNECore.eco().account().createAccount(
299            identifier, yaml.getString("Info.Name"),
300            !(type.equalsIgnoreCase("player") || type.equalsIgnoreCase("bedrock")), true);
301    if(!response.getResponse().success() || response.getAccount().isEmpty()) {
302      return Optional.empty();
303    }
304
305    final Account account = response.getAccount().get();
306    account.setStatus(TNECore.eco().account().findStatus(yaml.getString("Info.Status")));
307    account.setCreationDate(yaml.getLong("Info.CreationDate"));
308    account.setPin(yaml.getString("Info.Pin"));
309    finishAccountLoad(yaml, identifier, account);
310    return Optional.of(account);
311  }
312
313  private void finishAccountLoad(final YamlDocument yaml, final String identifier, final Account account) {
314
315    if(account instanceof final PlayerAccount playerAccount) {
316      playerAccount.setLastOnline(yaml.getLong("Info.LastOnline"));
317    }
318    if(account instanceof final SharedAccount shared && yaml.contains("Members")) {
319      loadMembers(yaml, shared);
320    }
321    final Collection<HoldingsEntry> holdings = TNECore.instance().storage().loadAll(HoldingsEntry.class, identifier);
322    for(final HoldingsEntry entry : holdings) {
323      account.getWallet().setHoldings(entry);
324    }
325    account.clearDirty();
326    PluginCore.callbacks().call(new AccountLoadCallback(account));
327  }
328
329  private void loadMembers(final YamlDocument yaml, final SharedAccount shared) {
330
331    final Section section = yaml.getSection("Members");
332    for(final Object memberObj : section.getKeys()) {
333      final String member = (String)memberObj;
334      for(final Object permissionObj : section.getSection(member).getKeys()) {
335        final String permission = (String)permissionObj;
336        shared.addPermission(UUID.fromString(member), permission,
337                             yaml.getBoolean("Members." + member + "." + permission));
338      }
339    }
340  }
341
342  /**
343   * Used to load all objects of this type.
344   *
345   * @param connector The storage connector to use for this transaction.
346   *
347   * @return A collection containing the objects loaded.
348   */
349  @Override
350  public Collection<Account> loadAll(final StorageConnector<?> connector, @Nullable final String identifier) {
351
352    final Collection<Account> accounts = new ArrayList<>();
353
354    for(final File file : IOUtil.getYAMLs(new File(PluginCore.directory(), "accounts"))) {
355
356      try {
357        final Optional<Account> loaded = load(file, file.getName().replace(".yml", ""));
358        if(loaded.isPresent()) {
359          accounts.add(loaded.get());
360          TNECore.eco().account().uuidProvider().store(new UUIDPair(loaded.get().getIdentifier(), loaded.get().getName()));
361        }
362      } catch(final Exception ignore) {
363        PluginCore.log().error("Issue loading account file. File: " + file.getName() + ". You may need to remove this account file! This is due to a previous server crash or improper shutdown and not a bug.", DebugLevel.OFF);
364      }
365    }
366    return accounts;
367  }
368}
